**Partitioning:** Divide the scene into spatially-disjoint blocks.
**Local Training:** Train an independent 3D Gaussian Splatting model for each block.
During training, the block is treated as an isolated scene.
**Appearance Decoupling:** Handle varying lighting conditions independently per block.
**Merging:** At render time, combine the contributions from all blocks.
